recipes.label: AA Gun: Change Orientation
recipes.startdescription: The steel mount grinds harshly through mud and smoke, the dark muzzle turning toward another direction.

recipes.label: Damaged Anti-Air Gun!
recipes.startdescription: The rigors of war have taken a toll on this gun emplacement. The tongues of flame that tore the sky have suddenly been extinguished. It needs repairs to be functional again.

recipes.label: Fire a foe with an AA gun [Medium]
recipes.startdescription:
This might be explicitly prohibited under some wartime treaty, but we can't worry about that now — the enemy is about to overrun this position!

[This requires at least 6 <sprite name=lantern>, 6 <sprite name=winter>, and 18 <sprite name=edge>. The more provisions you put in, the higher the success rate of the mission. If your target has already been weakened, then the success rate of this mission is 100%. This will likely cause the anti-air gun to be damaged.]
